_how_to: Add an app as another { } entry at the end of the "services" list, separated from the previous one by a comma. Then refresh LabMap – no restart needed.

Fields: name (required), description, port or address (e.g. "smb://{host}/media" – {host} becomes the server's address), path (e.g. "/admin"), https: true (if the app only works over https), icon (photos, cloud, folder, film, music, home, chart, server, app), color (e.g. "#10b981"), containers (a list of Docker container names whose state the app shows).
"type" adds extras for Immich, Nextcloud and Samba – leave it out for other apps.
Docker apps with a published port that aren't listed here show up on their own.

services.name: Immich
services.description: Photos and videos from everyone's phones

services.name: Nextcloud
services.description: Files in the browser and on the phone

services.name: Samba
services.description: Network drive for Finder and Explorer
